title: Reconstructed holograms and explanation-aware evaluation for low-cost computational pollen analysis in veterinary cytology
abstract: arXiv:2609.23017v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated pollen analysis supports veterinary cytology, but brightfield microscopy is costlier and more complex than lens-less digital in-line holographic microscopy. We evaluate whether reconstructed holograms can narrow this gap and whether model explanations remain reliable under modality change. Six pollen species were imaged by brightfield and holographic microscopy. Raw, single back-propagation and iterative phase retrieval holograms were evaluated with YOLOv26s detection and MobileNetV4 classification after anchor-based annotation transfer. Six attribution methods were assessed for spatial grounding and faithfulness with the Attribution Health Inspection and Repair (AHIR) protocol, which tests model brittleness under weak noise and corrects attribution-map granularity when needed. translated_title: 重建全息图与解释感知评估用于兽医细胞学中低成本计算花粉分析
translated_abstract: 自动化花粉分析可支持兽医细胞学，但明场显微镜比无透镜数字同轴全息显微镜成本更高、系统更复杂。我们评估重建的全息图能否缩小这一差距，以及模型解释在模态变化下是否仍然可靠。研究对六种花粉分别用明场和全息显微镜成像。在基于锚框的标注迁移之后，使用YOLOv26s检测和MobileNetV4分类对原始全息图、单次反向传播和迭代相位恢复全息图进行评估。采用归因健康检查与修复（AHIR）协议对六种归因方法的空间定位能力和忠实性进行评估，该协议在弱噪声下测试模型的脆弱性，并在需要时修正归因图的粒度。明场显微镜在检测上达到0.6890 mAP50-95（0.8865 mAP50），在分类上达到0.9687宏F1（0.9705准确率）。重建的全息图（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究证明重建的无透镜全息显微图像结合YOLOv26s检测与MobileNetV4分类可低成本实现兽医细胞学中的花粉自动分析，并提出AHIR协议检验模型解释在模态变化下的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that reconstructed lens-less holographic microscopy images combined with YOLOv26s detection and MobileNetV4 classification enable low-cost automated pollen analysis in veterinary cytology, and proposes the AHIR protocol to verify the reliability of model explanations under modality change.
